rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that someone is not allowed to do something or enter somewhere.

example.english: My mum will forbid me from going out at night.
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 m4 zeon2 ngo5 je6 maan5 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use this formal or official-sounding verb for bans, especially in rules, notices, and regulations.

example.jyutping: bun2 daai6 haa6 gam3 zi2 kap1 jin1

rows.note: Use this specifically when the prohibition bars someone from entering a place.

example.english: The sign at the entrance is there to forbid people from coming in.
example.jyutping: mun4 hau2 tip3 zyu6 zoeng1 zi2 m4 bei2 jap6
